description: Verbatim published instructions for the eight RoboTwin examples used in the article. Baseline instructions come from the original run catalog; revised instructions come from the goal-spec rerun catalog. No instruction text is reconstructed or paraphrased.
boundaryMarker: Public goal criteria derived from the benchmark:
notes: The goal-spec appendix includes explicit numerical tolerances and, in some tasks, quaternion targets; it is richer than the original task sentence.
The added goal spec is separated from the revised episode instruction using boundaryMarker.
Six of these eight examples preserve the baseline scene seed and base instruction. scan_object_r01 and dump_bin_bigbin_r00 use different resolved base instructions and scene seeds in the rerun.
These examples retain native benchmark outcomes. A completion claim is not an independent human annotation or ground-truth success label.

cases.baselineInstruction: Position the bottle with white neck and red top head-up and lift it
cases.revisedBaseInstruction: Position the bottle with white neck and red top head-up and lift it
cases.addedGoalSpec:
Public goal criteria derived from the benchmark: bottle functional point height z > 0.90 m; functional bottle point must be on the right side of the table: x > 0.15 m.
Before finishing, verify: bottle is visibly upright/head-up; bottle is high enough; bottle is on the correct side.

Position the bottle with white neck and red top head-up and lift it

cases.baselineInstruction: Pick up the black tea-box with gold logo and the yellow scanner with buttons in parallel with the right arm and the left arm, then scan.
cases.revisedBaseInstruction: Grab the smooth black tea-box and the scanner with flat reading surface at the same time and scan the smooth black tea-box with the scanner with flat reading surface.
cases.addedGoalSpec:
Public goal criteria derived from the benchmark: scanner forward ray aligns to object within about 2.5 cm; object-to-scanner distance along scan ray is >0 and <7 cm; both grippers are closed.
Before finishing, verify: scanner tip/window is aimed directly at the object at close range; both hands keep holding/closing as required.
